newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khalifa says that current developments necessitate UAE military readiness and the continued development of the armed forces.
- Investment and trade cooperation expected to flourish between Russia and the UAE under joint investment protection pact and accord to end double taxation.

- Controversy erupts over $650 million refinery project in Pakistan planned as a joint venture with the Sharjah-based Crescent company, which said that the project had been terminated for invalid reasons.
- UAE's first federal environmental law to be implemented in December, imposing fines and targeting vehicle emissions, marine pollution and waste disposal.
